message: does not parse (Opening tag "button" not terminated.)
$reason: An unbalanced quote in the trigger's start tag, `class="pct-widget__trigger type="button"`. Angular's own parser refuses the template (`Opening tag "button" not terminated`), as the build and prettier do, and point 1 says what the parser says. A hint part and an option below the trigger are in the text, and the walk of a template that does not parse reaches neither: asked first, the counts of message parts and of roles requiring a context would refuse it for want of a walk, which the parser's error explains. A count of widget tags over the text stood before the parse and refused this template as an unbalanced quote swallowing the rest of the file. It said the same of a `<` in a condition swallowing a button the tree holds (`button-swallowed-by-an-expression`), of a tag the scan read and the count did not, and of a `<button>` quoted in a `title`, which breaks nothing and which the reference's marker holds.
